correctness.rationale: The triangle and ordinary P4 trace obstructions are necessary and sufficient for star forests; choosing centers and selected leaves realizes all traces. The component-center and dominating-set constructions prove both inequalities for VC = n-gamma, including isolates. Component weights 1,1,r give exp(z exp(zt)-z^2t/2). For m~c n^(2/3), the P4 path is strictly balanced; the fixed-m hypergeometric factorial-moment argument yields Poisson(4c^3), with triangles negligible. Independently executed verifier tested 33,867 all-subset cases, all 1,099 host graphs through five vertices for VC identity, and 3,586 further samples; finite tests are not the general proof.

value.rationale: The theorem identifies a natural complete shattering invariant for every graph and shows it is exactly n minus domination number, with the corresponding complexity transfer. It gives an exact labeled enumerator on complete graphs and a sharp n^(2/3) Poisson probability law with constant 4. These connected structural, enumerative, and stochastic results address a natural Boolean rank-two range system rather than a narrow arbitrary numeric slice.
